mapper.sql:
HAVING 1 = 1
AND SUM(CASE WHEN m.hq_status = 'READY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
AND COUNT(m.id) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN m.hq_status IS NOT NULL AND m.hq_status != 'DELETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
AND SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'IMAGE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'IMAGE' AND (m.lq_status IS NULL OR m.lq_status != 'READY') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
AND SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'IMAGE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'IMAGE' AND (m.lq_status IS NULL OR m.lq_status != 'READY') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c.id as comic_id, c.title, NULL as cover_url, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.id) as chapter_count, COUNT(m.id) as page_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.hq_status = 'READY' THEN COALESCE(m.file_size, 0) ELSE 0 END) as hq_size, SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'IMAGE' AND m.lq_status = 'READY' THEN COALESCE(m.lq_size, 0) ELSE 0 END) as lq_size, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.hq_status) as hq_status, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'IMAGE' THEN m.lq_status END) as lq_status, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'VIDEO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'IMAGE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 'VIDEO' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'IMAGE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'VIDEO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 'IMAGE' ELSE 'MIXED' END as media_type FROM comic c LEFT JOIN chapter ch ON ch.comic_id = c.id LEFT JOIN page m ON m.chapter_id = ch.id AND m.media_type IN ('IMAGE', 'VIDEO') WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
AND c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')
AND c.category_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM category cat WHERE cat.id = c.category_id AND cat.name = #{query.category})
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comic_tag ct WHERE ct.comic_id = c.id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comic_tag ct JOIN tag tg ON tg.id = ct.tag_id WHERE ct.comic_id = c.id AND tg.name = #{query.tag})
GROUP BY c.id
) t
ORDER BY t.hq_size ORDER BY t.lq_size ORDER BY t.title ORDER BY (t.hq_size + t.lq_size)
DESC ASC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT c.id as comic_id, c.title, NULL as cover_url, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.id) as chapter_count, COUNT(m.id) as page_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.hq_status = 'READY' THEN COALESCE(m.file_size, 0) ELSE 0 END) as hq_size, SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'IMAGE' AND m.lq_status = 'READY' THEN COALESCE(m.lq_size, 0) ELSE 0 END) as lq_size, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.hq_status) as hq_status, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'IMAGE' THEN m.lq_status END) as lq_status, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'VIDEO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'IMAGE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 'VIDEO' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'IMAGE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'VIDEO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 'IMAGE' ELSE 'MIXED' END as media_type FROM comic c LEFT JOIN chapter ch ON ch.comic_id = c.id LEFT JOIN page m ON m.chapter_id = ch.id WHERE c.id = #{comicId} GROUP BY c.id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT c.id FROM comic c LEFT JOIN chapter ch ON ch.comic_id = c.id LEFT JOIN page m ON m.chapter_id = ch.id AND m.media_type IN ('IMAGE', 'VIDEO') WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
AND c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')
AND c.category_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM category cat WHERE cat.id = c.category_id AND cat.name = #{query.category})
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comic_tag ct WHERE ct.comic_id = c.id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comic_tag ct JOIN tag tg ON tg.id = ct.tag_id WHERE ct.comic_id = c.id AND tg.name = #{query.tag})
GROUP BY c.id
) t

SELECT ch.id as chapter_id, ch.chapter_no, ch.title, COUNT(m.id) as page_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.hq_status = 'READY' THEN COALESCE(m.file_size, 0) ELSE 0 END) as hq_size, SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'IMAGE' AND m.lq_status = 'READY' THEN COALESCE(m.lq_size, 0) ELSE 0 END) as lq_size, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.hq_status) as hq_status, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'IMAGE' THEN m.lq_status END) as lq_status, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'VIDEO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'IMAGE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 'VIDEO' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'IMAGE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN m.media_type = 'VIDEO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 'IMAGE' ELSE 'MIXED' END as media_type FROM chapter ch LEFT JOIN page m ON m.chapter_id = ch.id AND m.media_type IN ('IMAGE', 'VIDEO') WHERE ch.comic_id = #{comicId} GROUP BY ch.id ORDER BY ch.sort_order
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.transcode_status) FROM comic c JOIN chapter ch ON ch.comic_id = c.id JOIN page m ON m.chapter_id = ch.id AND m.media_type = 'VIDEO' WHERE c.id = #{comicId}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.hq_status = 'READY' THEN COALESCE(m.file_size, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hq_bytes, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.lq_status = 'READY' THEN COALESCE(m.lq_size, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lq_bytes FROM page m JOIN chapter ch ON ch.id = m.chapter_id JOIN comic c ON c.id = ch.comic_id WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comic WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
